brief_bug_summary_human_paraphrase: In _guess_quote_and_delimiter, one of the regex alternatives for matching quoted fields contains a stray '>' character inside a character class: `(?P<delim>>[^\w\n"'])` instead of `(?P<delim>[^\w\n"'])`. The bugged regex never matches the intended trailing-quote pattern, so sniffing of certain quoted csv layouts misidentifies or misses the delimiter.
